video_prompt: One continuous full-frame close-up shot in a dim room at night with a large window showing blurred city lights behind; the video fills the whole frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. The man — a man about 36 years old with olive Mediterranean skin, a clean-shaven bald head and a full dark beard, wearing a plain black t-shirt — wearing black over-ear headphones, speaks into the black podcast microphone, alone in the shot, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same distance from the camera. Locked-off camera on a tripod; the background stays still. The man talks toward the left, where the other host sits off-camera, curious and surprised, asking a question, with small natural head movements.
